headings.usage_rules: Do NOT use Inter for headings. Use Manrope for a friendly, rounded 'Soft Utility' feel.

layout_and_spacing.widget_container: w-full sm:w-[420px] max-h-[85vh] sm:max-h-[800px] flex flex-col shadow-2xl rounded-t-3xl sm:rounded-3xl border
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Left-aligned content for forms and lists. Centered empty states.

surfaces_and_micro_themes.floating_button: Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-2xl bg-white/70 border-white/40 (Light) or bg-black/60 border-white/10 (Dark). High saturation.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.panels: Solid backgrounds. No glassmorphism inside the dense editor to ensure readability.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.inputs: Neumorphism mix: flat background (bg-zinc-100/bg-zinc-800), 1px subtle border, sharp text.

navigation_and_interactions.tabs: Keep the existing 4 tabs (Elements, Cards, Layout, Bot). Use a clean, pill-shaped segmented control design (Shadcn Tabs with rounded-full trigger styles).
navigation_and_interactions.drill_down_navigation: CRITICAL: The requirement 'صفحه بعده صفحه متتابعه' means Stack Navigation. When a user clicks to edit a Custom Card, an Element, or any complex form, DO NOT expand it inline. Instead, slide in a new view from the side (like iOS settings or chat info). This nested view must have a 'Back' button in the header. The same goes for any secondary actions.
navigation_and_interactions.page_selector: Instead of a basic <select>, use a sleek Shadcn DropdownMenu or an animated horizontally scrollable pill list at the top.

components.buttons: Rounded-xl or rounded-full. Generous padding (px-4 py-2). Active states must darken.
components.forms: Use Shadcn Input, Textarea, and Select. Wrap in clean Label groups.
components.icons: Use 'lucide-react' (already installed). Add Stroke width 2.5 for a stronger, bolder look.

motion.transitions: Use framer-motion for the drill-down stack navigation. x: 100% -> 0% with ease-out stiffness.
motion.hover: Subtle scale (scale-[1.02]) and border color darken.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install 'framer-motion' if not present, to handle the drill-down page sliding animations.

Refactor LiquidSiteBuilder.jsx to replace inline editing with a 'Stack' state. For example: const [activeView, setActiveView] = useState({ type: 'main' }); When editing a card: setActiveView({ type: 'edit-card', cardId: 123 }).
When activeView is not 'main', render the drill-down view with a fixed header containing a '< Back' button. Only the current view should be visible in the chat-sized container.
Update LiquidBuilderBotTab.jsx to use the same soft utility styling, removing the raw cyan borders and replacing them with the new Pastel & Soft palette.
Ensure the floating toggle button uses the Crystal Glassmorphism pattern.
Make sure all text has proper contrast, especially over the Butter Yellow accent.

Ensure RTL/LTR direction is respected (use start/end classes like ps-4, pe-4, ms-auto instead of hardcoded left/right if the app supports Arabic). The prompt uses Arabic, so assume RTL layout for translations, but use generic Tailwind.
